title: Batched Seq2Seq Training and Decoding Utilities
prompt:
Complete a small batched sequence-to-sequence utility set. `shift_targets(targets, bos_id)` prepends BOS and removes the final target token. `masked_cross_entropy(logits, targets, pad_id)` averages cross entropy over non-PAD targets only, preserving gradients for those positions; loss inputs contain at least one non-PAD target. `greedy_decode(model, source, bos_id, eos_id, max_steps)` must run batched decoding without tracking gradients, append per-row greedy tokens, and stop once every row has emitted EOS; pass `eos_id=None` to disable early stopping. The returned batch starts with BOS. A finished row emits EOS on later steps while other rows continue, and the whole batch stops when all rows are finished. `max_steps=0` returns just the BOS column.

`ReverseModel(vocab_size, embed_dim)` is a trainable module whose forward path takes a source batch and decoder input batch and returns logits of shape `(batch, decoder_length, vocab_size)`. Use batch-first tensors throughout. This exercise checks the utilities and trainable forward path; it does not train or evaluate a learned sequence-reversal model.

example.reasoning: Teacher forcing predicts each target from its preceding decoder token.
